definition: a person you often write letters to
description: A young woman with long black hair and a mustard cardigan sits at a wooden desk by a window over a rainy garden, laughing as she writes a letter with a fountain pen. A pressed pink flower lies on an open envelope, and next to it is a thick bundle of airmail envelopes with colourful stamps tied with a ribbon. She lifts the pen to her lips, smiles and writes on. A bottle of ink, a mug of tea and a stand with a handwritten letter are on the desk, and a cat sleeps on the window seat.
